continuitySourceGapPolicy: Route labels are not continuity taxonomy categories. Categories without Stage 1 source text are source-gap/candidate-only; do not invent continuity facts.
appearancePolicy: Route events must link appearance/outfit changes when source explicitly describes them; otherwise not-found.
outfitEquipmentPolicy: Record equipment used in route summaries only when source-backed.
abilityActivationPolicy: Extract abilities activated in event summaries, preserving raw route labels.
combatEffectPolicy: Every candidate event with combat must record process/result/effect or not-found-in-source.
relationshipPolicy: Event relationship changes are candidate signals only; formal edges require later audited extraction.
timelinePolicy: Every future formal event must have start/end and timeline nodes; at prep stage preserve raw labels and route ordering only.
notFoundPolicy: If a route summary lacks exact trigger/completion/time, keep relative-only and not-found/source-limitation markers.
gateCriteria: supporting routes without direct source remain candidate-only
